in_hebrew.name: Kenyon
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Kenyon הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek 'Kenos' meaning empty and 'Yon' meaning young. In ancient Greek culture, the name Kenyon was given to boys born during a time of peace and prosperity.
